title: UniversalVTG: A Universal and Lightweight Foundation Model for Video Temporal Grounding

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: To process long videos, typical pipelines must chunk the video and repeatedly reencode frames [26,43,53], which is computationally prohibitive and scales poorly.

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: UniversalVTG: A Universal and Lightweight Foundation Model for Video Temporal Grounding Video temporal grounding (VTG) is typically tackled with dataset-specific models that transfer poorly across domains and query styles.

problems.name: Dataset, Benchmark, and Evaluation Mismatch
problems.evidence_sentence: Because benchmark-centric supervision encourages models to overfit to these dataset-specific linguistic conventions and visual regimes, a model optimized for one dataset typically degrades substantially when applied to another (Table S3).

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: We present UniversalVTG, a single VTG model trained with large-scale cross-dataset pretraining.

methods.name: LLM Reasoning, Agentic Workflows, or RL Post-Training
methods.evidence_sentence: Moreover, despite being $>100\times$ smaller than recent MLLM-based approaches, UniversalVTG matches or exceeds their accuracy on multiple benchmarks, offering a practical alternative to parameter-heavy MLLMs. # Abstract Video temporal grounding (VTG) is typically tackled with dataset-specific models that transfer poorly across domains and query styles.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Whether a user is retrieving “the moment I left the stove on” from egocentric footage, or a creator is searching for “the decisive goal,” the system must align free-form text with precise temporal boundaries.
